svg.text: Four concept owners agree one written brief - concept_to_coordinator.md. A robot delivery team, including each owner's personal robot, executes it.
Four humans agree the concept together, in writing; each human's personal robot captures their discussion into the brief.
Scope, spend and go-live decisions stay at this level.
each personal robot can also clarify
the one agreed brief - the Coordinator reads its orders here
every concept change is recorded - full change history
QC verdict - a fail stands, no override
assigns and manages all delivery roles
sole writer - one batch per turn
Assistant robot - coordination, building, review, records
Reasoner robot - architecture and QC judgment seats
capture / orders / writes to the brief
direct clarification - cannot override the brief
Neutral placeholders - the concept owners assign names, owners and roles. The delivery team is expandable, not unlimited capacity.
ROLE CIRCLES ARE RESPONSIBILITIES, NOT DISTINCT ASSISTANTS
One main delivery job per assistant. Human 4: Builder + Records only while Records is mostly idle.
If Records becomes busy, reassign it. Coordinator and Reviewer need separate delivery assignees.
Keep own-human interaction and relay. Independent QC stays separate from Builder; a fail still stands.
